records.text: Nate and Joanna are friends who greeted each other after a long time apart and discovered they share similar interests.
Nate won his first video game tournament playing the team shooter Counter-Strike: Global Offensive with his team, in the week before 21 January 2022.
Nate found winning the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive tournament exciting and said he and his team had a blast to the very end.
Joanna has been working on a project lately (as of 21 January 2022), which she described as pretty cool.
Joanna enjoys writing, reading, watching movies, and exploring nature.
Joanna is not into video games.
Nate's main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies.
Nate loves action and sci-fi movies, especially their cool effects.
Joanna likes dramas and romcoms, and loves getting immersed in the feelings and plots of movies.
Nate believes movies can be very powerful.
Nate asked Joanna for movie recommendations.
Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships to Nate. She shared a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench.
Nate loves watching classic movies.
Nate plans to check out the romantic drama about memory and relationships recommended by Joanna soon.

Joanna first watched the romantic drama about memory and relationships around 3 years before 2022-01-21 (around 2019). She got a physical copy and shared a photo of the DVD on a table with a blurry background.
Joanna has seen the romantic drama about memory and relationships a few times; it is one of her favorites. She likes the idea and the acting.
Nate said he will definitely check out the recommended movie and thanked Joanna for the recommendation.
Joanna asked Nate to let her know if he likes the recommended movie.
On 2022-01-21 (Friday), Joanna finished and printed her first full screenplay, sharing a photo of the printed book with a page of text.
Joanna's first full screenplay is a mix of drama and romance.
Joanna feels a rollercoaster of emotions—relief, excitement, and some anxiety—about finishing her first full screenplay.
Joanna plans to submit her finished screenplay to film festivals and hopes to get producers and directors to check it out, aiming for positive feedback and new opportunities.
On 2022-01-23, Nate shared a photo of a turtle and a turtleling sitting on a rock.
Nate has had his pet turtles for 3 years (since about 2019); they bring him tons of joy and have big personalities despite being small.
Nate recommends having small pets like his turtles for times of stress to keep calm when nervous.
Joanna is considering getting pets of her own soon, but only if she can find ones she is not allergic to.
Nate started hanging out with some people outside his usual circle at the tournament; he finds them pretty cool.
Joanna thinks Nate's new friendships with tournament competitors sound sweet and wonders if the competitor relationship makes it weird.
On 2022-01-23, Nate said that some people at the tournament are more competitive than others, so Nate tends to stick around the more chill people there.
On 2022-01-23, Nate said he would cheer on others even if he loses, that he does not expect to win big at the tournament, and that he just likes playing for fun.
Joanna has really bad animal allergies: her face gets puffy and itchy when she is around certain animals, so she has always stayed away from them.
Joanna is allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur; she finds the allergies a bit of a drag but finds other ways to be happy.
Joanna said that writing and hanging out with friends bring her joy: writing lets her express herself through stories, and hanging out with friends lets her have a good time with people.
Nate said he was glad that Joanna has other things to help her get through times of anxiety despite not being able to have animals.
Joanna said writing helps her create wild worlds with awesome characters, is a great way to express her feelings, and that she cannot imagine life without it.
Nate told Joanna that her writing sounds amazing and encouraged her to keep doing what she loves.
Joanna said she will definitely keep pursuing her passion for writing, and that Nate's support means a lot to her.

On 2022-02-07, Joanna told Nate her submitted screenplay has been on her mind all day every day; she bounces between relief, excitement and worry, and hopes a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen.
Joanna put a lot of effort into her screenplay and is crossing her fingers about the film festival submission.
On 2022-02-07 Nate supported Joanna over her film festival screenplay submission, sending positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen.

On 2022-02-07 Nate told Joanna he recently discovered he can make coconut milk ice cream, gave it a try and it turned out pretty good; he is proud of himself and shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it.
Nate found his homemade coconut milk ice cream super good, rich and creamy, and said it might be his new favorite snack.
Nate plans to make his coconut milk ice cream again and is looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
Nate loves coconut milk and also enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavors for dairy-free desserts.
On 2022-02-07 Joanna shared a photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate while discussing dairy-free dessert flavors.
Nate told Joanna he made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it 'the other day' (shortly before 2022-02-07) and suggested she might like it.
Joanna praised Nate's cooking skills as awesome, said she is tempted to try dairy-free flavors, and joked she should make one herself or pay Nate a visit to try his creations.
Nate says it is always fun experimenting in the kitchen.
As of 2022-02-07 Nate had not seen any good movies recently and asked Joanna for recommendations.
Joanna watched the movie 'Little Women' on or before 2022-02-07.
Joanna thinks 'Little Women' is amazing and a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for dreams; she recommends it as a must-see.
After Joanna's recommendation, Nate plans to watch the movie 'Little Women' and added it to his watch list.
Joanna enjoys giving movie recommendations and says she's always down to do so.
Nate plans to ask Joanna for movie recommendations whenever he runs out of things to watch.
Joanna asked Nate to let her know what he thinks of 'Little Women' after he watches it; Nate agreed to tell her his thoughts first.
On 2022-02-25, Nate apologized to Joanna for not being around recently.
On 2022-02-25, Nate told Joanna he had made chocolate and vanilla swirl ice cream for a friend, and the friend loved it.
On 2022-02-25, Nate shared a photo of a person holding a chocolate and vanilla ice cream cone.
Joanna cannot have dairy, so she does not eat ice cream.
Nate plans to send Joanna a dairy-free ice cream recipe that uses coconut milk.
Joanna is keen to try Nate's dairy-free coconut milk ice cream recipe and is always up for something sweet.
Nate is all about desserts and asks Joanna to let him know what she thinks after trying the recipe.
Joanna says Nate's cooking is amazing and that she loves his creations; she promises to keep him posted.
Nate says it means a lot to him that Joanna enjoys the desserts he bakes.
On 2022-02-25, Joanna told Nate she cannot stop thinking about her screenplay, so she started writing another screenplay while waiting to hear back about how the first one did.
On 2022-02-25, Nate asked Joanna what her new screenplay is about.

Joanna's new screenplay is about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss; the main character deals with loss and figuring out who they are, and takes a road trip to heal and grow. Joanna says it is somewhat similar to her previous screenplay and is inspired by her personal experiences and her own journey of self-discovery.
Nate finds Joanna's new screenplay topic deep and awesome, loves stories that tackle important issues, thinks it takes guts, and says he can't wait to see it come together.
Joanna hopes her submitted screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen; she is waiting with fingers crossed.
Nate crossed his fingers for Joanna, hoping her screenplay finds a fan and is given its due, and wished her good luck.
Joanna told Nate that she has wrapped up her second screenplay/script, and that the feelings have been wild.
Joanna felt a mix of relief and anxiety, excitement and terror after finishing her second script, thinking about her work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.
Nate congratulated Joanna on wrapping up her second script and told her her hard work and dedication will get noticed, and hoped she could take time to relax.
Joanna is decompressing after finishing her script but finds it hard to switch off, describing a tug-of-war of hope and doubt.
Nate told Joanna that having doubts is normal, that she worked hard and put tons of passion into her script, and that she should believe in herself because things will work out.
Nate shared a photo with Joanna of two tortoises lying on the ground in a jungle, saying that walking them always reminds him to enjoy the small stuff.
Nate has two tortoises that he walks, and they remind him to enjoy the small stuff.
Nate values enjoying the small stuff in life.

On 2022-03-18, Joanna saw Nate's photo of Nate's two tortoises on the ground outside and called the photo adorable; Joanna said the tortoises always look relaxed outside and asked Nate why Nate chose them as pets.
On 2022-03-18, Nate said Nate is drawn to turtles; Nate finds turtles unique, their slow pace a nice change from the rush of life, and them low-maintenance and calming.
On 2022-03-18, Nate shared a photo with Joanna of three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said Nate's turtles look peaceful and that it is amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy; Joanna asked whether taking care of them is tough.

On 2022-03-18, Nate said caring for turtles/tortoises is not really tough; Nate said it involves keeping their area clean, feeding them properly, and making sure they get enough light, and Nate finds it kind of fun.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said having pets must be a wonderful experience.
On 2022-03-18, Nate said pets bring tons of joy, are always there for people, and are cute; Nate said relaxing with pets is a great way to chill.

On 2022-03-18, Joanna said Joanna wishes Joanna were not allergic and would get two turtles today if Joanna could; Joanna recently found out Joanna is allergic to cockroaches as well, and Joanna is unsure whether Joanna will ever get a pet.
On 2022-03-18, Nate planned to send Joanna photos of Nate's turtles so Joanna can watch them grow without getting too close; Nate suggested Joanna might consider other animals.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna liked Nate's idea of sending turtle photos and said Joanna is already really invested in Nate's little turtles.
On 2022-03-18, Nate said pets really seem to have that effect on everyone.
On 2022-03-18, Nate asked Joanna about Joanna's script and whether Joanna had ideas for the next steps.
Joanna told Nate she has been doing non-stop research and networking for her script project; she finds it tough but is determined to make it happen.
Nate told Joanna that networking and research should get more eyes on her script and encouraged her to keep up the hard work.
Joanna thanked Nate, saying his support means a lot, and said she will keep working and hopes the next steps become clearer soon.
Nate advised Joanna not to quit, telling her the path forward will show up soon and that she's got this.
Joanna said that having someone support her throughout the whole process is a blessing and gives her motivation to keep pushing forward.
Nate told Joanna he is glad his support makes a difference and that he is there for her.
Before saying goodbye, Joanna shared a photo of a cinema ticket on a chair.
On 24 March 2022, Nate and Joanna reconnected after a while, with Nate saying crazy stuff had been happening since they last chatted.
On 23 March 2022, Joanna had an audition for a writing gig.
Joanna described the audition for the writing gig as going alright, with mixed emotions - she was definitely excited but also a bit anxious.
Nate told Joanna he has faith in her, asked her to keep him posted, and said she's got this.
Joanna said Nate's support means a lot and promised to keep him updated about her writing gig audition.
Nate is currently participating in a video game tournament again on 24 March 2022, describing it as intense with lots of adrenaline flowing.
Joanna wished Nate the best of luck in the video game tournament and noted it sounds difficult to go through so many days of intense gaming.
Joanna shared a photo of a bookshelf filled with books and magazines, calling it her go-to place for writing inspiration that helps her stay sharp and motivated.
Nate saw the photo of Joanna's bookshelf, remarked it was a lot of books, and asked her for advice on pursuing writing.

Joanna's writing advice to Nate: read lots and try different genres, build a solid understanding of literature, don't be afraid to write and share even if just with friends, practice and gather feedback to improve, have faith in yourself, and keep following your writing dreams because it's tough but worth it.
Nate thanked Joanna for her help and kind words and said he is going to keep working hard on his writing and see what happens.
Joanna thanked Nate for his kind words and support and suggested they keep going for their dreams and work hard.
Joanna is interested in pursuing writing and finds her bookshelf of books and magazines a source of inspiration to stay sharp and motivated.
Nate wants to pursue writing and is working hard at it, inspired by Joanna's advice.
Nate dyed his hair purple in the week before 2022-04-15.
Nate shared a photo of himself with purple hair and glasses taking a selfie on 2022-04-15.
Nate has purple hair and wears glasses as of 2022-04-15.
Nate chose purple hair color because it is bright and bold like him; he wanted to stand out from regular options.
Nate is stoked about his new purple hair.
Joanna shared a photo of a street with a stop sign and a cloudy sky on 2022-04-15, which she described as a gorgeous sunset she saw while hiking the other day.
Joanna went hiking on or around 2022-04-13 and saw a gorgeous sunset.
Joanna finds Nate's boldness inspiring; it reminded her of the importance of showing the world who we are.
Joanna wishes she had a vacation lined up, but her writing is consuming her as of 2022-04-15.
Joanna is hoping for good news soon about her writing, likely the audition outcome from 2022-03-23.
Nate asked Joanna to keep him posted on how her writing goes; Joanna agreed to keep him updated.
Nate and Joanna plan to see each other soon.
On 2022-04-17 at 6:44 pm, Nate and Joanna had a conversation; Nate noted they hadn't talked in a while and asked how Joanna was doing.
In the week before 2022-04-17 (approximately 2022-04-10 to 2022-04-17), Joanna was reading a lot; she found many good books she had forgotten she owned.
Nate said he probably has many books he hasn't read in years, as of 2022-04-17.
Nate thought Joanna's reading of old books sounded fun and like a blast from the past, on 2022-04-17.
On 2022-04-16, Joanna found an awesome hiking trail in her hometown; she described it as gorgeous and inspiring.
Nate is not really into hiking but was curious to see what Joanna's trail looks like; he mentioned hearing about a nice trail just north of where he lives.
Joanna suggested she might convince Nate to go hiking with her one of these times; Nate said maybe, since he likes nature and it might be fun going with someone else.

Joanna is a huge fan of nature; walking in it, feeling it, and hearing the sounds is calming and a haven for her, making worries and stress vanish. She calls nature awesome and goes because she loves it.

Nate finds nature inspiring and agrees it is crucial to find peace and remember life's beauty; for him that comes from spending time with his pets and engaging in his hobbies, which let him take a break from reality.

Joanna and Nate agreed that small things make life enjoyable and worth it; taking time for little friends and doing loved activities are treasures that remind them how great and peaceful life is, and should be savored.
On 2022-04-17, Nate shared a photo of a turtle and a strawberry in a bowl; Joanna called it so cute and said she loves Nate's turtles so much.
Nate has pet turtles that he loves watching play to enjoy peaceful moments; he sometimes brings them into the kitchen so they can watch him make food.
On 2022-04-17, Nate shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream and a bowl of sprinkles; Joanna said she loves his ice cream and wishes she could make it the way he does.
Nate's ice cream is dairy-free and very easy to make; he offered to give Joanna the recipe.
Joanna is lactose intolerant, so she needs dairy-free recipes.
On 2022-04-17, Nate shared his dairy-free ice cream recipe with Joanna after she asked for the dairy-free version.
Nate's dairy-free ice cream recipe uses coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt; after chilling it in the fridge, he puts it in an ice cream maker and freezes it until scoopable.
Joanna thought Nate's dairy-free ice cream recipe sounded delicious and thanked him for sharing it.
Joanna planned on 2022-04-17 to try making Nate's dairy-free ice cream recipe that night (2022-04-17).
On 2022-04-17, Nate told Joanna he was glad he could help and asked her to let him know how the dairy-free ice cream turns out.
Joanna promised Nate she would let him know how the dairy-free ice cream turns out.

On 2022-04-21, Joanna told Nate she had just joined a writers group, describing its members as inspirational people who really get her writing, and said she feels motivated and supported, like she finally belongs somewhere.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna shared a photo of a notebook with a notepad and a piece of paper to illustrate her writers group news.
On 2022-04-21, Nate shared a photo of a cup of ice cream with a cherry on top.
Nate believes having a supportive group around you can really make a difference, and told Joanna her writers group news was awesome.
Joanna is working with her writers group on a script called "Finding Home," about a girl on a journey to find her true home; she finds the project rewarding and emotional.
Nate thinks Joanna's script "Finding Home" sounds really special and must be meaningful to work on.
Nate has a gaming tournament in May 2022 (next month from 2022-04-21); he is feeling good about it and it will be his 4th tournament.
Nate and Joanna are friends who reconnect via messages; on 2022-04-21 Joanna greeted Nate with "long time no talk" and they caught up on her writers group and his upcoming gaming tournament.
Joanna is passionate about writing and values feeling supported and like she belongs in her writing community; her work on "Finding Home" is emotional and rewarding for her.
On 2022-04-21 at 7:44 pm, Joanna shared a photo of a man in a striped suit performing on stage; Nate asked if it was her, and Joanna confirmed that the photo is of her.
Joanna recalled that when she did her first play, she was so nervous she forgot her lines; it was embarrassing but taught her how important it is to prepare and stay in the moment.
Joanna said acting was her first passion, but now she shines in writing; writing helps her express herself in a new way, and she may go back to acting someday.
Joanna enjoys dramas and emotionally-driven films.
Joanna plans to keep writing, and may give acting a try if acting calls out to her.
Nate encouraged Joanna to follow her passion for writing, but to try acting again if it really makes her happy.
Nate asked Joanna whether any particular movies spark her writing.
Nate shared a photo of a turtle lying on a bed of rocks and gravel on 2022-04-21.
Nate loves fantasy and sci-fi movies, saying they are a great escape and get his imagination going.
Nate says playing video games is a great way to express his creativity and passion.
Nate shared a photo of a black Xbox controller sitting on top of a wooden table on 2022-04-21.
Joanna said she loves how video games can spark imagination.
Joanna asked Nate what his favorite fantasy or sci-fi movie is; the question was not answered in this segment.
On 2022-04-21, Nate told Joanna that a trilogy is one of his favorites, praising its world building, battles, and storytelling, and shared a photo of a shelf containing many books.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna asked Nate what books he enjoys and requested new book recommendations, saying she is always up for new book recommendations.
On 2022-04-21, Nate recommended a book series to Joanna, describing it as having adventures, magic, and great characters and calling it a must-read; he shared a photo of a bunch of books on a table.
Nate loves a book series/trilogy with adventures, magic, great characters, world building, battles, and storytelling; he considers it a must-read.
As of 2022-04-21, Joanna had heard of the book series Nate recommended and said it had been on her to-read list forever.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna planned to check out the book series Nate recommended and to let Nate know her thoughts afterward.
On 2022-04-21, Nate and Joanna ended their chat with goodbyes; Nate said it was good chatting and wished Joanna a great day, and Joanna said take care and have a great day.
On the night of 2022-05-01 Joanna watched The Lord of the Rings trilogy, which Nate had recommended to her, and thought it was awesome; she shared a photo of a person holding a book open.
Nate thinks The Lord of the Rings is probably the greatest trilogy of all time.
On 2022-05-02 Nate shared a photo of his gaming room with a computer and a gaming chair.
Joanna said she was proud of Nate and that his gaming room looks great.
Nate says gaming has been his main focus: he practices a lot and has even won a few tournaments.
In the week before 2022-05-02 (around 2022-04-25 to 2022-05-01) Nate won his second gaming tournament.
On 2022-05-02 Nate shared a photo of a woman with purple hair wearing a black dress.
Nate usually plays CS:GO, but he entered a local Street Fighter tournament since he plays Street Fighter a lot with his friends, and he won it, discovering he is really good at it.
Nate plays Street Fighter a lot with his friends and usually plays CS:GO.
Nate described winning the Street Fighter tournament as super awesome, with lots of adrenaline in the final match; the other finalist shook his hand.
On 2022-05-02 Nate said life had been ok and asked Joanna what she had been up to.
On 2022-05-02, Joanna shared a photo of a cake with white frosting on a wooden table that she made recently.
Joanna's cake is dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting.
Joanna has been working on some projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and family.
Joanna loves experimenting in the kitchen; cooking and baking are her creative outlets.
Joanna finds making dairy-free desserts a rewarding challenge and loves seeing the smiles on everyone's faces when they try it, calling it a total win.
Nate previously recommended coconut to Joanna, and she really likes the recommendation.
Nate complimented Joanna's cake, saying it looks really good and amazing, and that she is talented at making dairy-free desserts.
Nate said goodbye ("Bye!") at 11:54 am on 2022-05-02, ending the conversation with Joanna.
Joanna went hiking and discovered new amazing trails in her town during the week of 2022-05-02 to 2022-05-12, calling it an awesome experience and saying she now feels like an expert hiker.

Joanna shared a photo with Nate on 2022-05-12 of a waterfall with a dark sky in the background, taken at a location called Whispering Falls; she said the rush of the water was soothing and the spot was peaceful and serene.
Joanna hiked at a beautiful location called Whispering Falls; she described it as really peaceful and serene and loved that spot on the hike.
Nate loved the look of Joanna's Whispering Falls photo, especially the dark sky and green scenery, and said he wished he could have been there, adding that her hikes sound like a blast.
Joanna finds nature totally inspiring and calming; the sound and beauty of nature make her feel calm and peaceful, with everything else fading away so only the present matters.
Joanna says hiking has opened up a whole new world for her and she feels like a different person now.
Joanna feels she could write a whole movie when she is out in cool natural places; on these trails she felt especially like writing a drama, and she thinks about her life when out and about.
Nate said that being out in nature makes him get deep in thought and think about his life or new recipes.
Nate and Joanna reconnected on 2022-05-12 at 3:35 pm and caught up on the week since they last talked (2022-05-02).
Nate suggested to Joanna that they should go together sometime, and Joanna invited Nate to come down and join her on the trails sometime; Nate accepted the invitation.
Nate said he might start to think of a drama himself and publish his own screenplay.
Joanna reacted enthusiastically to Nate's idea of writing and publishing his own screenplay, saying it would be something.
At 3:35 pm on 2022-05-12, Nate thanked Joanna for the trail invitation, Joanna said 'Sure thing Nate! See you later!', and Nate replied 'See ya!' to close the chat.
On 2022-05-20 at 7:49 pm, Nate told Joanna he had just gotten a new addition to the family: an adopted dog named Max, and shared a photo of Max lying on a couch in a living room.
Nate's dog Max is adopted, is full of energy, fills Nate's life with joy, and keeps Nate's other pets (his turtles) active.
Joanna thinks Max is adorable and says pets sure do make life better; she is glad Max is bringing Nate lots of joy.
Nate believes pets make people much happier and never let us down.
Joanna told Nate she had just finished something, calling it a pretty wild journey; she did not specify what it was. Nate congratulated her.
Nate described the week since he and Joanna last talked (around 2022-05-12) as a busy one.
Nate asked Joanna whether she had thought any more about getting a pet of her own.
Joanna has pet allergies, so she does not want to get any pets, and she says she is too lazy to research alternative pets for her allergies.
Nate says it is nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, even though he feels it is unfortunate Joanna cannot have pets.
Joanna says writing and creative projects are what get her through tough times, and she is grateful for her supportive friends.
Nate thinks writing and creative projects can be therapeutic and that positive relationships have a great impact.
Joanna says it is priceless to have friends who understand and appreciate her work and who she can talk about it with and receive feedback from.
Joanna shared a photo of a notepad with a dog on it and a pen as a look at the writing she has been working on, saying it had been quite a journey but she made it.
Joanna confirms the writing she just completed is her third one.
Joanna chose to write her third work because it is really personal; it is about loss, identity, and connection, a story she had for ages but only just got the guts to write.
Joanna likes writing about sadness and loss; she says she had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics, and she writes best when being true to herself even if it is hard.
Joanna believes meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings.

Nate congratulated Joanna on finishing her third personal writing work, saying it takes guts to explore her experiences and feelings and that he is proud of her for staying strong and being true to herself.
Joanna told Nate that his support means a lot and that knowing people like him are cheering her on makes her journey easier.
Nate tells Joanna she has tons of talent and potential and encourages her to keep going and reach for her dreams.

A few days before 2022-05-25, Nate took his dog Max for a walk and ran into a super nice couple who also had a dog; it turned out the couple lives close by, and Nate and the couple decided to do doggy playdates.
Nate's dog Max really likes the nearby couple's dog.
Nate became friends with a couple who live near him and own a dog, bonding over their shared love of animals despite having little else in common; they plan doggy playdates.
Nate and the nearby couple plan ongoing doggy playdates so Max has a walking buddy and can play with the couple's dog.
Nate thinks the love of animals alone was enough common ground with the couple to make good friends, even though they share little else.
Nate really enjoys watching the pets play with one another and calls it a dream come true to see his dog Max so happy.
Joanna finds it uplifting and rewarding to connect with other pet owners on walks, and encouraged Nate to keep meeting people that way.
Joanna believes that having a peaceful presence (someone or something) to come home to helps relieve stress and provides a sense of calm for relaxation.
Nate gave Joanna a stuffed animal (a toy pup) as a gift on 2022-05-25, saying it is to remind her of good vibes.
Nate shared a photo of a stuffed animal lying on a bed on 2022-05-25.
Joanna finds the stuffed animal from Nate very cute, loves the thought, and says she will cherish it with all her heart.
Nate says the stuffed animal is like having joy in your pocket and always makes him grin when he looks at it.
Joanna appreciates small joys like the cute stuffed animal and considers it a nice reminder.
Nate believes that little things make life better and that finding and cherishing them prevents getting down.
Joanna will always remember moments that bring happiness and remind her that life is great.
Joanna reflects that during the tough times finishing her screenplay, those joyful moments make the journey worth it.
Nate agrees that little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times, and that enjoying the ride is key.
Joanna believes that appreciating the journey and being aware of happy moments keeps us focused on our dreams.
Joanna plans to show her screenplay to Nate and values his opinion on it.
Nate is supportive of Joanna's screenplay and can't wait to see it.
Joanna thanked Nate for his support, said it is greatly appreciated, and promised to keep him updated.
Nate encouraged Joanna by saying she's got this and to keep it up.

Joanna received a rejection letter from a major company after finishing her screenplay, which really bummed her out; the letter was generic with little feedback, and she found not knowing why it didn't work out disheartening.
Nate told Joanna that rejection stinks but doesn't mean she isn't talented, urging her not to give up on her dreams and to keep believing in herself.
Joanna was discouraged by the screenplay rejection but resolved not to let it bring her down, and thanked Nate for his support.
Nate won another regional video game tournament in the week before 2022-06-03, described as a huge confidence boost that showed his hard work paid off.
At the regional tournament Nate met new people, and connecting with fellow gamers always feels awesome to him; he also met some guys there who said they wanted to hang out later.
Nate offered to give some tips to the new tournament acquaintances on how to improve their game, saying he just likes helping people.
Nate shared a photo of a purple and blue controller with a star field design.
Joanna told Nate she has been following his tournaments throughout the years and is happy for his progress; Nate noted it has been a while since his first tournament.
Joanna planned to go hiking with some buddies during the weekend of 2022-06-04 to 2022-06-05, checking out a new trail with an impressive waterfall.
Nate is organizing a gaming party for the weekend of 2022-06-18 to 2022-06-19 (two weekends after 2022-06-03), expecting it to be hectic but fun.
Nate plans to invite his tournament friends, some old friends, and teammates from other tournaments to his gaming party, and to give everyone custom controller decorations just for coming.
Joanna praised Nate for helping strangers and stepping outside his comfort zone, congratulated him on the tournament victory, and wished him the best for his gaming party.
On 2022-06-03, Joanna told Nate that she thought his idea (custom controller decorations for his gaming party) was sweet and that the recipients would love it.
On 2022-06-03, Nate agreed with Joanna's praise ("I know right?"), told her to have a great hike and to take lots of pictures, and said goodbye.
On 2022-06-03, Joanna thanked Nate and said she would see him later, ending their conversation.
On 2022-06-04, Joanna wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen; she found it nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive and called it a roller coaster.
On 2022-06-05 at 2:12 pm, Joanna shared a photo of a Spider-Man poster hanging on a wall while talking to Nate.
Nate noticed a Spider-Man pin on Joanna's purse the last time they saw each other before 2022-06-05.
Joanna's favorite superhero is Spider-Man; she likes Peter Parker's struggle between being a hero and being a person, and she also likes any superhero for their own stories and powers.
Nate's favorite superhero is Iron Man; he loves Iron Man's technology and sarcastic humor.
